PLAN "12-Week Prenatal Strength Programme with Nutrition Plan and Cardio - Core Focus - Summary"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain/moderate to progressive intensity in Phase 2 with emphasis on core strength, upper pressing, and safe overall conditioning through pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower/Upper pattern A":
        warmup: walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        core:
          dead_bug 3x12 per side
          side_plank 3x20s per side
        cardio: walking 10 minutes
        cooldown: chest_stretch 60s, lat_stretch 60s
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower/Upper pattern B":
        warmup: rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cardio: cycling 10 minutes
        core: pallof_press 3x10..12 per side, dead_bug 3x12 per side
        cooldown: hip_flexor_stretch 60s, shoulder_stretch 60s
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Core/anti-extension focus":
        warmup: walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          suitcased_walk 3x30s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 per side rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 per side rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20s per side rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cardio: elliptical 10 minutes
        core: cat_cow 60s, hollow_hold 3x20s
        cooldown: cat_cow 60s, child_pose 60s
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper/Lower progression A - INTENSITY PUSH":
        warmup: jogging in place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x6..10 rpe 6-7 rest 75s
          hip_thrust 4x6..10 rpe 6-7 rest 75s
          dumbbell_row 4x6..10 rpe 6-7 rest 75s
          incline_press 4x6..10 rpe 6-7 rest 75s
          bench_press 4x6..10 rpe 6-7 rest 75s
        cardio: brisk walk 15 minutes or 5 minutes easy jog + 5 minutes cycling
        cooldown: lat_stretch 60s, chest_stretch 60s
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower/Posterior chain focus - PUSH INTENSITY":
        warmup: cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x6..10 rpe 6-7 rest 75s
          Romanian_deadlift 4x6..10 rpe 6-7 rest 75s
          cable_row 4x6..10 rpe 6-7 rest 75s
          dumbbell_press 4x6..10 rpe 6-7 rest 75s
        cardio: rowing 10 minutes
        core: pallof_press 3x12 per side, side_plank 3x30s per side
        cooldown: back_stretch 60s, shoulder_stretch 60s
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Stability and mobility with INTENSITY BEAMS":
        warmup: walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60s
          glute_bridge 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60s
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60s
          tricep_extension 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60s
          push_up 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60s
        cardio: walk 20 minutes or 2x10 minutes intervals
        cooldown: piriformis_stretch 60s, scapular_roll 60s
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Volume maintenance + technique + core emphasis":
        warmup: elliptical 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x6..10 rpe 6 rest 75s
          hip_thrust 4x6..10 rpe 6 rest 75s
          barbell_row 4x6..10 rpe 6 rest 75s
          bench_press 4x6..10 rpe 6 rest 75s
        core: pallof_press 3x12 per side, dead_bug 3x12 per side, plank 3x20s
        cardio: moderate cycling 15 minutes
        cooldown: hamstring_stretch 60s, chest_stretch 60s
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Unilateral emphasis with pressing support":
        warmup: jogging in place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 4x6..10 rpe 6 rest 75s
          single_leg_glute_bridge 4x8..12 per leg rpe 6 rest 75s
          lat_pulldown 4x6..10 rpe 6 rest 75s
          incline_press 4x6..10 rpe 6 rest 75s
          push_up 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60s
        core: side_plank 3x30s per side
        cardio: rowing 12 minutes
        cooldown: hip_flexor_stretch 60s, shoulder_stretch 60s
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Core + pelvic floor support with upper press cueing":
        warmup: walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          cossack_squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60s
          pallof_press 3x10..12 per side rpe 6 rest 60s
          dead_bug 3x12 per side rpe 6 rest 60s
          side_plank 3x30s per side rpe 5 rest 60s
          dumbbell_press 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 75s
        core: plank 3x20s
        cardio: brisk walk 15 minutes or easy bike 15 minutes
        cooldown: cat_cow 60s, child_pose 60s
End: End Plan

NUTRITION PLAN
  GOAL
    name "Support pregnancy needs while preserving lean mass; adequate energy, protein, micronutrients, and glycemic stability"
  GUIDELINES
    - Calorie: modest energy balance 0 to +150 kcal/day above preconception maintenance
    - Protein: 1.6–1.8 g/kg/day
    - Carbs: 3–5 g/kg/day, fiber-rich
    - Fats: unsaturated fats, essential fatty acids
    - Micronutrients: iron, calcium, vitamin D, choline, iodine, folate, zinc, magnesium
    - Hydration: 2.2–3.0 L/day
    - Timing: pre/post workout nutrition within 1–2 hours
    - Constipation, caffeine: as previously outlined
  TESTING NOTE
    - Peak week non-max strategy; OB clearance required for any 1RM testing; use submax where approved
END PLAN

  GOAL

    - Seek medical guidance for any adverse symptoms during nutrition plan or training

    - Avoid supine exercises after 20 weeks; ensure positions are comfortable
    - Modify core work to avoid valsalva risk; breath control and pelvic floor engagement
    - No contact sports; avoid high-impact or collision risk
    - Seek medical guidance for any adverse symptoms during nutrition plan or training
